coordinates: doubled Bourbaki E8 coordinates: roots are (+-2,+-2,0^6) permutations and (+-1)^8 with an even number of minus signs (norm^2 8); a line is represented by its root whose first nonzero coordinate is positive
pairs_meaning: nine ordered pairs [a_j, b_j]; term j has reader functional lambda_{a_j} (readers t with B0[t][a_j] = 1) and source functional lambda_{b_j}; the eighteen lines are punctured
found_by: exhaustive-order backtracking with the first ordered orthogonal pair fixed (W(E8) is transitive on ordered orthogonal pairs of lines); the first system reached, not a census
